title: Auditing dependence assumptions in multifidelity CFD: verification records
description: The v3.1.0 release asset contains seven verification archives and a unified saved-record verification entry point. The exact aggregate asset is archived at version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23112322. The repository source snapshot is not the aggregate asset. Code is MIT; authored numerical data and documentation are CC BY 4.0. Probabilities are conditional numerical-pathway diagnostics, not physical failure probabilities. No manuscript text, private reviews or restricted physical-experiment data are included in the release asset. Creator metadata was corrected on 2026-10-03. Released files and their checksums are unchanged; creator lists embedded in the deposited files reflect the pre-correction build metadata.
